name: Hunting cap
description: A red and black checked wool cap with a short peak and ear flaps that tie up over the crown or fold down over the ears.
notes: Standing on its band, 220 mm across and 270 mm from back to peak: a red wool crown crossed with dark bands for the plaid, a stiff peak at +z and ear flaps tied up round the sides. No plaid finish exists, so the plaid is raised dark rings and ribs. The model stands upright round a head-sized space, so its bounding box is large. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Knit hat
description: A close-fitting grey wool hat knitted with a ribbed cuff turned up round the brow.
notes: Standing upright, 190 mm across and 200 mm tall: a rounded knit crown over a ribbed felt-grey cuff. The model stands upright round a head-sized space, so its bounding box is large. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Eight-point cap
description: A cotton utility cap with a flat eight-cornered top and a short cloth peak, standard issue to sailors and marines.
notes: Standing on its band, 225 mm across the top and 270 mm from back to peak: a crown flaring to a flat octagonal top with seams to each corner, a cloth peak at +z. Finish cloth-ucp, as no camouflage print exists. The model stands upright round a head-sized space, so its bounding box is large. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Newsboy cap
description: A soft wool cap whose full eight-panel crown slouches forward over a short stiff peak, gathered to a cloth button on top.
notes: Standing on its band, 250 mm across and 265 mm from back to peak: a full crown set forward over the peak at +z, panel seams running to a button on top. The model stands upright round a head-sized space, so its bounding box is large. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Padded ear covers
description: Two thick cotton pads joined by a cord, tied over the ears to muffle sound.
notes: Laid flat, 300 mm across: two round pads 90 mm wide with dark rims and a stitched centre, joined by a doubled cord, loose ties at each end. New slot `ears`: the pads go over the ears under or beside a hat, and no existing slot fits. Blocking sound is a hearing effect Deadvox has no field for yet; record it once hearing protection exists. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Sombrero
description: A broad-brimmed orange felt hat with a tall crown, worked in rings of white and yellow stitching, with a cord chin strap.
notes: Resting on its brim, 600 mm across and 260 mm tall: a broad brim rolled up at the edge, a tall tapering crown, white and yellow stitched rings on brim and crown and a cord chin strap lying across the brim at +z. The model stands upright round a head-sized space, so its bounding box is large. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Headscarf
description: A navy cotton scarf worn wrapped over the head and neck, leaving the face open.
notes: Folded square, 220 mm by 200 mm and 36 mm tall with its pin: four folds of navy cloth, a hemmed edge at +z and a pin through one corner. Slot `hood`: it sits under any hat as coifs do; it also covers the arms, which one slot cannot express. A looser folded scarf is plausible. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Skullcap
description: A small round cotton cap that sits on the crown of the head.
notes: Resting on its rim, 150 mm across and 32 mm tall: a shallow black dome with a band of cream stitching near the rim and twelve stitched marks above it. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Kufi cap
description: A short brimless cotton cap with straight sides and a rounded top, embroidered round the band.
notes: Standing on its rim, 180 mm across and 92 mm tall: a cream cap with a rounded top edge, a yellow embroidered band of bars between two rings and a ring on the crown. The model stands upright round a head-sized space, so its bounding box is large. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Frilled headpiece
description: A stiff white crescent band edged with a pleated frill and threaded with black ribbon, tied on at the back of the head.
notes: Laid flat, 220 mm across and 100 mm deep: a white crescent band at +z with a pleated ruffle round its outer edge, a black ribbon along it with a small bow at the front and a tie at each end. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Face veil
description: A black cotton veil that covers the face below the eyes, leaving a narrow slit to see through, tied on at the back.
notes: Folded flat, 220 mm by 200 mm and 22 mm tall, its ties trailing 70 mm past the back: the eye slit's bound edges show on the top fold, two ties trail from the back corners at -z. New slot `face`: the veil is worn over the face with a headscarf, so neither `head` nor `hood` fits; it would also suit masks and bandanas tied over the face. It also covers the head and arms, which one slot cannot express. The ties stretch the bounding box; the cloth itself folds small. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Pointed hat
description: A tall black cone of cotton on a wide flat brim, its tip bent over, with a purple band and a brass buckle.
notes: Resting on its brim, 400 mm across and 330 mm tall: a broad flat brim and a tall cone stepping over toward +x until its tip bends sideways, a purple band and brass buckle facing +z. Finish cloth-charcoal so the cone's shading reads against black. The model stands upright round a head-sized space, so its bounding box is large. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Porkpie hat

The model stands upright round a head-sized space, so its bounding box is large. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
